bullets.text: Israel has re-established a closed West Bank settlement, leading to international protests and concerns from nearby Palestinian residents.
A Russian drone strike on a Ukrainian mall reportedly killed 15 people and injured 130 others, including 23 children.
Over 100 people have died in a goldmine collapse in the Central African Republic due to a landslide, with the death toll expected to rise.

Australia is expected to experience its wettest El Niño on record, with another rainband set to bring significant rainfall across the nation this week, despite El Niño typically being associated with drought.

A year after the Dezi Freeman shootings, the Victorian High Country town of Porepunkah is moving forward, with businesses reporting a recovery in tourism after the lockdowns, though divisions in the community reportedly linger.

Australia, along with the UK and Canada, has condemned Israel's decision not to pursue criminal investigations into the drone strike in Gaza that killed seven humanitarian workers, including Australian Zomi Frankcom, calling the decision 'shameful'.

US ranchers are protesting Donald Trump's plan to cut taxes on beef imports, as the former president claims unnamed foreign suppliers will offer a 25% discount ahead of midterm elections, raising concerns about domestic impact.

Citadel has offloaded over 80% of the aggregate risk from the Situational Awareness stock portfolio it acquired from the AI hedge fund, with Ken Griffin's firm executing more than $4 billion worth of block trades recently.

Bond markets are causing unease among rich-world politicians as yields climb ominously, despite stock indices continuing to rise, highlighting a potential disconnect and renewed link between power and fiscal capacity.
